Three independently completed jobs in [run40521736562](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40521736562) each pass **712/712 tests**, zero failed/skipped/cancelled, then exit1 because aggregate branch coverage is **99.36%**, below the unchanged **100%** gate:
- [npm release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40521736562/job/122250358103)
- [Bun release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40521736562/job/122250358035)

### Expected / actual and impact
The accepted [SDK adoption record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/7eac04c9cb33dcadf18dafffcb4e7a9fdf864381/.agents/pm/chores/pm-ado-sdk-adoption.toon) explicitly retains complete all-package gates at unchanged thresholds; the [epic](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/7eac04c9cb33dcadf18dafffcb4e7a9fdf864381/.agents/pm/epics/pm-ado-g4v1.toon) requires100% across configured dimensions. Actual complete hosted test pass is insufficient to satisfy the branch gate. This blocks the PR's complete gate evidence; it is distinct from earlier local packed-installer timeouts, not proof of broken user-facing behavior or SDK regression.

### Reproduction / acceptance
On this exact head, execute the repository's unchanged npm/Bun release gates and Node coverage job configuration, or inspect the linked preserved hosted output. Identify uncovered branches in the four reported modules and add meaningful behavioral cases (or justify a semantics-preserving removal of unreachable branches), preserving prior assertions, measured source inventory and all thresholds. Rerun the complete current-head Node22/26 and npm/Bun gates, including independent statement coverage and later release checks; retain counts and exact SHA. Do not weaken coverage or confuse a partial module run with complete acceptance.

Limits: hosted-evidence finding; no local full-suite rerun, live Azure calls, or causal base/head coverage experiment. No claim that all later release checks ran after the failing coverage phase. All58 open/closed issue/PR records, current PR discussion, and42 canonical PM records checked; no existing issue identified for this exact current shortfall. PR46 remains implementation owner.
